success_bar: AUC >= 0.65 (the bar monkey-mode/report.md established with the user; PRD names AUC as the metric but no separate numeric bar)
verdict: Clears the bar: test AUC 0.7361 > 0.65, and beats a true same-test-set re-run of monkey-mode's exact approach (0.6746) by +0.0615 AUC - confirming the feature engineering and model-selection work in this project produced a real improvement, not a CV or split artifact. baseline_metrics.accuracy is the majority-class baseline (= test set's own positive rate); baseline_metrics.auc_roc is monkey-mode's 12-raw-column RandomForestClassifier, retrained and scored on this project's exact kkbox_test.csv (modeling/rerun_monkey_mode_on_test.py) - not monkey-mode/report.md's originally-reported 0.6727, which came from its own independently-sampled split (that number was very close: 0.6727 vs. 0.6746 on the real test set, confirming the original comparison was a reasonable signal even before this rigorous re-run).
